title: Blackberry Granita
changes_from_base: Blackberries replace the strawberries, with a little less water.
summary: A refreshing frozen dessert made with fresh blackberries and lemon juice, processed into light and airy ice crystals.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Place 450 g blackberries, 160 ml water, 110 g caster sugar, 45 ml lemon juice and a pinch of salt in the blender. Process on high for 1-2 min until the mixture is very smooth.

steps.title: Strain
steps.text: Pour the liquid through a fine sieve into a 33 x 23 cm glass dish. Press with a spoon to remove all seeds and discard them.

steps.title: First freeze
steps.text: Place the dish uncovered in the freezer for about 1 h. Do not disturb the mixture during this initial cooling phase.

steps.title: Scrape
steps.text: Use a fork to scrape the frozen edges into the middle. Repeat this process every 30-60 min for 2-3 h to break up any large ice crystals.

steps.title: Mash
steps.text: Continue mashing any lumps with the fork until the texture is light and fluffy. Ensure the crystals are evenly distributed throughout the dish.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Fork the mixture one last time just before serving. Spoon the blackberry ice into chilled glasses for a refreshing finish.

tips: Use frozen blackberries if fresh berries are out of season.
Ensure the glasses are properly chilled to prevent the ice from melting too quickly.
Press the pulp firmly against the sieve to get the most flavour and colour.
storage: Keep the granita covered in the freezer for up to 1 week and use a fork to fluff the crystals before serving.
